items.statement: Independent calculations support the proposed host–guest organization in DMSO.
items.expected: Within the modeled 1:1 solution complex, a low-energy motif combines squaramide NH-to-carboxylate hydrogen bonds with aromatic stacking; it is selected from validated alternatives rather than assumed.

items.statement: The computed thermochemical and optical observables jointly support host–guest association.
items.expected: The DMSO interaction is favorable under the stated calculation convention and complexation produces a red shift; conclusions remain limited by conformer coverage, solvation, and method sensitivity.
